proposals.line: Flee when health is badly wounded or worse and three or more hostiles are adjacent, even if the target is nearly dead.
proposals.evidence: Died at 18:00:01 with five hostiles adjacent (Etakheki, Yagnar, a mongbat, a headless one, Diwarek) after Jev chose to keep fighting Kukgilug at 39%, 32%, 23%, 9% health (17:59:57 to 18:00:01, confidence 0.38 to 0.64). Flees were 0 for the whole run, and the strategy is empty, so no flee rule was in effect.

proposals.line: When more than two enemies are adjacent, don't keep attacking a target that is near death; step away from the crowd first.
proposals.evidence: The fatal sequence had a near-death target held for three decisions (17:59:59 to 18:00:01) while five enemies were adjacent and unhurt, and the character never got out of the crowd. Health fell from 32% to 9% during that stretch.

proposals.line: Flee as soon as health is near death while two or more hostiles are adjacent.
proposals.evidence: Died at 18:00:01 with 5 hostiles adjacent. Health went 39% -> 32% -> 23% -> 9% over about 4 seconds (17:59:57 to 18:00:01), and Jev kept choosing to fight Kukgilug at 0.64, 0.40, 0.42 and 0.38. Zero flees in the whole run, and the strategy is empty, so fleeing was never allowed.

proposals.line: Don't pick up or keep a new target while badly wounded with three or more hostiles adjacent; pull back first.
proposals.evidence: At 17:59:57 health was 39% with 5 hostiles adjacent, yet Jev chose to fight Kukgilug (badly wounded) at 0.60. That fight ended in the death at 18:00:01. Bandages applied during the sequence 'barely help' according to the journal.

proposals.line: Once health falls below half, lower aggression and don't engage new monsters until you are healthier.
proposals.evidence: Fight confidence averaged 0.91 across 136 fight decisions with aggression at the default 0.50, and the only death came from continuing to fight after health fell below half. The low-health moment at 17:58:41 (23%, one decision) recovered, which shows fights below half health are risky but survivable when they end quickly.

proposals.line: If I am badly wounded and three or more creatures are adjacent, flee right away instead of finishing the current target.
proposals.evidence: Died 18:00:01 with 6 hostiles adjacent. Jev chose fight at 39%, 32%, 23%, 9% and 9% (17:59:57–18:00:01) with confidence 0.38–0.64. Flees totalled 0 over 3 runs, even though the default reading is 'flees when losing'.

proposals.line: At near death with any unhurt creature adjacent, leave the area altogether. Don't try to kill a nearly dead target first.
proposals.evidence: At 18:00:00 health was 9% and Jev kept fighting a near-death orc while 5 unhurt hostiles were adjacent, and it died. At 17:58:41 it was also near death (23%) with 5 adjacent and only survived by luck.

proposals.line: Don't stand in a crowd. Back off and fight when no more than two creatures are adjacent. Rest to recover once the area is clear.
proposals.evidence: Both low-health moments (17:58:41 and 18:00:00) had 5–6 hostiles adjacent at once (orcs, ratmen, a mongbat, a headless one). Only 3 rest decisions in 151 decisions, and 9 corpses were still unlooted at both moments.

proposals.line: If I'm badly wounded and three or more enemies are adjacent, flee or leave the area instead of finishing the target.
proposals.evidence: Died at 18:00:01 while fighting at 39%→9% with 6 hostiles adjacent (17:59:57–18:00:01). Jev kept choosing fight at 0.38–0.64 confidence, and flees total 0. Earlier near-death at 18:58:41 (23%) with 5 adjacent also only recovered by luck. The default 'flees when losing' never triggered.

proposals.line: Don't wade into a pack: fall back so at most two enemies can reach me at once, and attack the weakest first.
proposals.evidence: Both low-health moments (17:58:41, 18:00:00) had 5–6 hostiles adjacent at once (orcs, ratmen, mongbat, headless one), mostly unhurt, while I focused a single target. 9 corpses were unlooted, so the pack kept growing.

proposals.line: When near death (under ~25%) with several enemies adjacent, leave the area and rest; don't keep attacking.
proposals.evidence: Health went 32%→23%→9% over about 2 seconds (17:59:59–18:00:00), and the next decisions were still fight at 0.42 and 0.38. Bandages (198) and 4 heal potions were mostly unused, so healing wasn't keeping up with damage from 6 attackers.

proposals.line: If you are near death and a monster is still adjacent, flee instead of fighting on.

proposals.line: When health drops to badly wounded or lower while fighting a gargoyle, disengage and leave rather than trade blows.
proposals.evidence: The fatal fight went from wounded (58%, 20:24:50) to near death (20%, 20:24:51) to death (20:24:55) against one gargoyle, with two more gargoyles in view. Jev kept attacking through the whole drop, with no flee at any point.

proposals.line: Don't keep fighting while two or more gargoyles are within 3 tiles of you and you are wounded.

proposals.line: When I'm near death (about 25% or lower) and my heal potion isn't ready, flee from the creatures close by instead of finishing the target, even if it's almost dead.

Heal potions were on cooldown ('not for another 2-7 seconds') and bandages slipped ('Your fingers slip!'). Flees: 0 for the whole session, even though the strategy text is blank (so the default is 'flees when losing').

proposals.line: Don't stay in a fight when I'm wounded (about 60% or lower) and more unhurt creatures are heading my way. Leave or fall back before they reach me.
proposals.evidence: At 20:24:50 I was wounded (58%) fighting one gargoyle, with two more unhurt gargoyles far away. Health fell to 20% by 20:24:51, and I died four seconds later. No flee or retreat was ever chosen (flees = 0).

proposals.line: When I am near death (about 20% or lower) and a monster is adjacent, flee right away. Don't keep fighting just because the target is almost dead.
proposals.evidence: Died at 20:24:55. Jev chose fight on 5 decisions in a row (20:24:50–20:24:55) while health went from 58% to 20–21%. Flees for the whole session: 0. The potion was on cooldown for those turns and bandages kept failing ('Your fingers slip!'), so healing was not keeping up.

proposals.line: Don't start or continue a fight with several gargoyles when I am wounded. Flee or leave the area before the unhurt ones arrive.
proposals.evidence: At death, one gargoyle was adjacent and two more were far away and unhurt. Health was already wounded (58%) at 20:24:50 and fell to near death within a second. The only death of the session came in this fight.

proposals.line: After fleeing, rest until health is high before seeking or fighting again.
proposals.evidence: Only 1 death, but it came from fighting while already wounded (58%) against a gargoyle group. Rest was cheap: 149 rest decisions at 1.0 confidence. Seek had 4 decisions below 0.5 confidence.

proposals.line: Don't engage bone knights when two or more are close; leave before they reach you.

proposals.line: Fight a single adjacent skeleton while health stays above half, and only leave once health drops below that or a second monster closes in.
proposals.evidence: Fight intent was used 41 times at average confidence 0.94 and produced all 4 kills with no deaths. The strategy is empty, so the default flee-when-losing rule triggered leaves at 63 and 100 health (04:30:21, 04:32:15).

proposals.line: When seeking a creature, choose the nearest hostile type you have already fought successfully rather than wandering.
proposals.evidence: Seek intent averaged 0.78 confidence with 2 of 9 decisions below 0.5. The hunts that stalled came after long stretches with nothing in sight (80 seconds each).

proposals.line: If a hunt has produced no kill after about a minute and nothing hostile is close, move to a different area with monsters rather than standing around.
proposals.evidence: Seven Britain Graveyard hunts of about 1.4 minutes each produced 0 kills and ended with Jev unsure twice running (stay here 0.45 to 0.53), from 03:58 to 04:28. The eighth hunt ended at 04:31 with 11 hostiles in sight, but only after 1.0 minutes with no kill.

proposals.line: Leave when a bone knight is close and you are below about two-thirds health, rather than trading blows with it.
proposals.evidence: Fled from bone knights at 63 health (04:30:21) and 28 health (04:31:11). At 04:31:17 health fell to 9% with a bone knight close and lightly wounded, and only the flee saved the run. No deaths occurred, and the strategy is currently empty, so this is a new rule.

proposals.line: Only seek a creature when you are unhurt and have bandages to spare; otherwise rest or leave.
proposals.evidence: Seek was the least confident intent: 9 times at average confidence 0.78, with 2 below 0.5. The lowest-confidence seeks were not followed by any kill in the digest.

proposals.line: Don't flee while health is above half from ratmen, lizardmen or orcs, even in a group. Fight them one at a time, starting with the closest.
proposals.evidence: At 04:32:15 Jev chose leave at 100% health with a ratman, a lizardman and an orc close. That flee lasted 94 decisions. There were 111 leave decisions against 41 fight decisions and only 4 kills in 62 minutes. The current strategy has no rule on when fleeing is worth it.

proposals.line: When nothing hostile is in sight and health is fine, seek the nearest creature instead of resting or staying put.
proposals.evidence: There were 943 rest decisions against 9 seek decisions. Seven Britain Graveyard hunts (03:58–04:28) each ended after about 1.4 min with 0 kills. Each time 'nothing hostile in sight for 80 seconds' and Jev was unsure about staying (0.45–0.53).

proposals.line: Don't take on a second bone knight. When two are close, leave before health falls below half.
proposals.evidence: At 04:31:11 Jev fled at 28% health with two bone knights close. Health reached near death (9%) at 04:31:17, and the character survived only because a heal potion was about to apply. At 04:30:21 it had already fled one bone knight at 63%.

proposals.line: Don't start a fight with a bone knight unless health is unhurt. Attack lone weaker creatures first.
proposals.evidence: The only low-health moment (9% at 04:31:17) and two of the three logged flees (04:30:21, 04:31:11) came from bone knights. Bandage use rose to 3 in that hunt, and the hunt ended with 0 kills at 04:31:23 with 11 hostiles in sight.

proposals.line: When nothing hostile is in sight, seek the nearest creature instead of resting or standing still.
proposals.evidence: 943 of 1112 decisions were rest, with only 4 kills in 62 minutes. Seven of eight hunts ended at about 1.4 min with 0 kills and 'nothing hostile in sight for 80 seconds' (03:58, 04:05, 04:12, 04:18, 04:20, 04:26, 04:28). Seek was used only 9 times.

proposals.line: Don't flee at full health from ratmen, lizardmen or orcs. Fight them one at a time and keep the wounded one as the target.

proposals.line: Don't take on two bone knights at once. Back off as soon as a second one is close, before health drops below about half.

proposals.line: Against bone knights, attack the one that is already wounded and leave early if health is under about 60%.

proposals.evidence: Three leaves at full health (23:36:29 with two gargoyles adjacent, 23:45:18 and 23:45:41 after the ogre and ettin pair). Two hunts ended on this rule and none ended in a death. The current strategy only sets a fleeing threshold for undead below 50% health, so this makes the stronger-creature case explicit.

proposals.line: If no creature is in view and you are unhurt, rest where you stand instead of seeking one out.
proposals.evidence: Seek decisions averaged 0.5 confidence, with 16 of 30 below 0.5 (rest averaged 0.85 over 1448 decisions). Three travel_to attempts got stuck 3 tiles short (23:29:12, 23:30:35, 23:31:55), so the wandering in search of targets was low-value.

proposals.line: When no enemy is close and I'm unhurt or only lightly wounded, seek the nearest undead right away instead of resting.
proposals.evidence: 1448 of 1664 decisions were rest (115 below 0.5 confidence), against 140 fights and only 30 seeks. Of those seeks, 16 were below 0.5 confidence and 7 decisions were gated for low confidence. The 15-minute hunt north of Britain got 19 kills, and no health problems showed up in the digest (0 deaths, 0 low-health moments). That suggests the time spent resting was mostly idle.

proposals.line: Rest only when I'm wounded or worse; if I'm unhurt, seek a creature instead.
proposals.evidence: Rest was the intent in 87% of decisions, but low_health shows 0 incidents and only 12 bandages were used in 45 minutes. Resting while healthy looks like wasted time. This tightens when to rest and doesn't touch the healing thresholds.
